source.title: Independent Dragonflight prospecting/milling original completed-cast source search

notes: Targeted original postlaunch 2022-2024 rank-specific prospect/mill operation exports and 0/1/2+ per-output material stack histograms. No new independently identifiable firsthand completed-cast per-material ledger found. Wowhead Illimited Diamond Bugy table is per nominal ore (not P(hit)) and neoslayyer first-person batches already appear in prior legacy research; superbondez Prismatic 80-cast study, Aary Saxifrage samples and Jan 2023 original Reddit cohorts are already documented. An archived 2022 beta milling guide is a prior, not new current-Retail measured yields. No source justifies zero-outcome inference, Resourcefulness reconciliation or new exact rank assignments. Do not count this as a sample.
lookingFor: New independent completed-cast / refund-audited per-output 0-N histogram for Draconium Ore (189143,188658), Serevite Ore (190394/190395/190396), Khaz'gorite Ore (190312/190313/190314), Prismatic Ore (194545), Bubble Poppy (191467), Saxifrage (191464/191465/191466) and Hochenblume (191462); secondary Dragonflight gear disenchant stack histograms.
